purpose: The forty tiles of the demo wall, so the video can be re-cut without re-recording and so forty tile positions do not live in JSX.
no_hold_rule: The wall reads DEV and CONFUSE only. It is built and re-run from D31, nine days before the constants freeze lets anyone open HOLD, so a HOLD tile here would make test_hold_untouched_until_freeze fail against this project's own build order. The rule has no exemption for the demo, and tests/test_corpus_integrity.py:test_wall_manifest_has_no_hold_id enforces it on this file.
caption: demo sequence: DEV arm -- the system's constants were fit on this fire. The headline number is measured on 54 held-out sequences it has never seen: 60 windows in data/manifest_hold.json, 6 excluded by data/excluded.json.

hold_denominator.note: The caption above quotes all three numbers and never one of them alone. data/manifest_hold.json names 60 windows, data/excluded.json drops 6 of them, and the headline is measured on the 54 that remain. Saying 60 on screen would quote a denominator this repo's own exclusion list had already reduced; saying 54 on screen without the other two makes six sequences look as though they went missing. The caption is the line a judge hears in the video, so it carries the subtraction rather than either end of it. scripts/bench.py:arm_denominator recomputes these three from the same two files at run time and refuses to publish a denominator they do not produce; tests/test_corpus_integrity.py:test_wall_caption_quotes_the_surviving_denominator and tests/test_denominator.py fail if this block drifts from them.
hold_denominator.disclosure: Producing data/excluded.json required a human to look at the FIRST FRAME of every HOLD window -- one frame per window, about 40 minutes before ignition -- against criteria stated before the pass ran. It is disclosed in data/excluded.json under hold_note, and it is repeated here because that is where the exclusion count is published. Nothing in plumerank/constants.py was chosen from it, and results/hold_access.log correctly records no HOLD read: no HOLD pixel has been scored.

fire_tile_selection: 20240622_Border58Fire_om-w-mobo-c, chosen by looking at t0-120s, t0, t0+360s, t0+720s and t0+1200s of all five DEV sequences whose frames are on disk. It is the one that matches the beat the demo is built on: nothing visible at t0 or t0+6 min, a faint smudge over the ridge by t0+12 min, and by t0+20 min a plume whose foot is pinned on the ridgeline and whose top has climbed -- which is S1 and S2 happening where a viewer can see them. It is also a full 81-frame window.
licence_note: FIgLib carries no SPDX licence and requires a credit reference. It is used for EVALUATION ONLY and never for training -- test_no_figlib_in_training enforces that, and it is what makes every Californian number cross-network out-of-sample by construction.

pending.note: The 39 non-fire tiles are real non-fire mornings on real cameras and they are not invented here. This file is honest about being short rather than carrying thirty-nine sequence ids that name nothing on HPWREN's servers. Regenerate it once the CONFUSE manifest exists.

confuse_selection: 39 of the 45 CONFUSE windows: the hardest window of every confusion class first, so no class falls off the wall, then filled by raw-S3 hardness descending. The six dropped windows are the six softest of the largest classes. Stated here whether or not the manifest exists yet, so a regeneration follows the same rule rather than inventing one.
